parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.story_points, t.priority, t.assignee_id, m.full_name AS assignee_name, COALESCE(m.productivity_score,100)::float AS productivity_score FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.project_id = '{{ $('Prepare Input').first().json.project_id }}'::uuid AND t.status <> 'DONE' ORDER BY CASE t.priority WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, t.created_at
